summary: Modified repository-context.ts to use multi-store-aware registry and project lookups.

Registry lookup: replaced loadRegistry(resolveLedgerRoot()) with getMultiStoreManager().getMergedRegistry() in multi-store mode — uses store-order priority for deduplication consistent with StoreRouter.

Project scanning: replaced LedgerStore.listProjectsByFolderNames(folders, ledgerRoot) (single store) with a loop over getStoreRouter().getAllStorePaths() scanning each store, with plan_path deduplication across stores.
Insight querying: replaced single KnowledgeStoreManager(ledgerRoot) with getMultiStoreManager().listKnowledge() for cross-store collation with deduplication by insight id.
Added safeListAllStoreRepositoryInsights() helper mirroring the existing single-store variant.

All branches guarded by isStoreContextInitialized() so legacy tests (which use vi.mock for ledger-root.js) continue to work via the else path or implicitly via the multi-store path (since getMergedRegistry in legacy mode reads from the same mocked resolveLedgerRoot()).
All 3777 tests pass (130 files).

comments.note: repository-context.ts now has two parallel code branches (multi-store and legacy) for registry lookup, project scanning, and insight querying. When project-resolver.ts is eventually updated to use MultiStoreManager, a similar deduplication pattern could be extracted into a shared utility to reduce branching across tool files.

safeListAllStoreRepositoryInsights() and safeListRepositoryInsights() are very similar. If MultiStoreManager.listKnowledge() is made the sole code path (dropping the legacy else branch), the single-store helper can be removed and only one function is needed.

summary: Build check: TypeScript compilation clean.
Regression: 3787 tests across 131 files — all pass.

AC1 — code inspection confirms getRepositoryContext() calls getStoreRouter().getAllStorePaths() and iterates each store via LedgerStore.listProjectsByFolderNames(), deduplicating by plan_path. getAllStorePaths() returns all configured store paths in config order (verified at storage layer).

AC2 — code inspection confirms registry lookup uses getMultiStoreManager().getMergedRegistry() which applies store-order priority deduplication by repository id. getMergedRegistry() is tested in multi-store-conflicts.test.ts with 4+ tests.
AC3 — 28 existing tests in repository-context.test.ts exercise the legacy (single-store) path and all pass, confirming behavior unchanged.

Insight querying uses getMultiStoreManager().listKnowledge() in multi-store mode with id-based deduplication. safeListAllStoreRepositoryInsights() correctly suppresses SlugValidationError while re-throwing I/O errors — consistent with single-store safeListRepositoryInsights() semantics.
No tool-level integration tests for multi-store code paths (excluded from WP-008 scope) — flagged as medium-priority improvement for a follow-up pass.

summary: WP-008 code-review PASS with one Fix-Forward applied.

Step 2 (registry): getMergedRegistry() with .find(e => e.folder_names.includes(repositoryName)) is correct. Store-order priority deduplication is consistent with StoreRouter.resolveStoreForWrite() — both use the same first-match-wins rule.
Step 4 (project scanning): Iterating getAllStorePaths() and deduplicating by plan_path is correct and sufficient. plan_path is the stable identifier for a project regardless of which store holds it.

Step 8 (insights): Delegating both global and repository scopes to MultiStoreManager.listKnowledge() is correct. safeListAllStoreRepositoryInsights() correctly mirrors the single-store variant's SlugValidationError suppression with I/O error re-throw.

Fix-Forward: replaced three independent isStoreContextInitialized() calls with a single const isMultiStore captured once at the top of the try block. No behavioral change — the singleton check always returns the same value within a single function call.

The parallel dual-helper pattern (safeListRepositoryInsights / safeListAllStoreRepositoryInsights) is a known trade-off of the guard-based branching approach. Developer noted this in their implementation comments. No action needed now; worth tracking for when the legacy path is eventually retired.

comments.note: Extracted a single const isMultiStore = isStoreContextInitialized() at the start of the try block, replacing three independent calls across steps 2, 4, and 8. Non-behavioral — the guard evaluates the same singleton check each time; caching it makes the invariant explicit: the function operates in either multi-store or legacy mode for its entire duration, not independently per step.

AC1/AC2 have no tool-level integration tests — the multi-store branches in repository-context.ts are covered only by inspection and storage-layer tests. The delegation logic is correct and minimal, but _internal tests equivalent to those added in WP-007 for project-lifecycle.ts would harden these ACs and match the test strategy established by WP-007.

[documentation-forward] The two safeListRepositoryInsights / safeListAllStoreRepositoryInsights helper functions share identical semantics (suppress SlugValidationError, re-throw all others). The API surface docs should note both helpers and their error-handling contract so future contributors don't inadvertently add a third variant without the SlugValidationError guard.
